# Request a ZeroRank AI visibility study

What do you want to know about the brands AI engines recommend or the pages they cite? Tell us your category and the question your buyers ask. Send a question by [email](mailto:support@zerorank.ai?subject=ZeroRank%20study%20request) or copy the short form below into a pull request. [How to submit your request](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#request-a-study)

## What geographies and engines do you want tested?

Name the countries or markets that matter to your buyers, then choose the engines, search modes or direct API models you want compared. Specify the language you want the buyer questions written in. If you’re unsure about coverage, write “please recommend” and tell us which market matters most.

```text
Research question and who would use the answer:
Countries or markets to test:
Prompt language(s):
AI engines, search modes or API models to compare:
```

**Example request** “Which customer service platforms do ChatGPT and Google AI Mode recommend to a global retailer with 2,000 support agents? Compare the US, UK and Canada using the same English questions in each market. Which vendors appear when buyers require regional data storage, and which sources do the engines cite?”

When we compare countries, we ask the same buyer questions in the same language in each market. If you also want to test a different language, name that comparison separately. [Explore our research datasets](../../data/README.md)

## Engines you can request

Our model guide lists **39 tracking options**. We count each search mode and model version separately. Country coverage varies by engine. Doubao, Baidu Wenxin and Baidu AI Search use their mainland China experiences. Tell us which combinations matter to you and we’ll check coverage as we plan the study. [Our model and provider guide](https://docs.zerorank.ai/tracking/ai-models) · [Our changelog](https://zerorank.ai/changelog)

### Consumer web experiences

Choose from these 24 options to study what buyers encounter in an assistant or search product. For example, a request for “ChatGPT” can specify the standard experience, ChatGPT Web Search, or both.

| Provider | Engine or mode |
| --- | --- |
| OpenAI | ChatGPT, ChatGPT Web Search |
| Google | Gemini, Google AI Mode, Google AI Overview |
| Perplexity | Perplexity |
| Microsoft | Bing Copilot, Bing AI Mode |
| Meta | Meta AI |
| DeepSeek | DeepSeek Web Chat |
| Alibaba | Qwen Web Chat |
| ByteDance | Doubao |
| DuckDuckGo | DuckDuckGo, Duck.ai · GPT-6 Luna, Duck.ai · GPT-5.4 mini, Duck.ai · Mistral Small 4, Duck.ai · GPT-OSS 120B, Duck.ai · Gemma 4 31B |
| Amazon | Amazon Alexa |
| Baidu | Baidu Wenxin, Baidu AI Search |
| Brave | Brave Leo |
| Naver | Naver AI Tab, Naver AI Briefing |

### Direct API models

Choose from these 15 versions to study the answer a model returns through its API. For example, choose DeepSeek Web Chat and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash if the difference between the consumer and API experiences is the question you want to investigate.

| Provider | Model version |
| --- | --- |
| OpenAI | GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6.1 Sol Search |
| Anthropic | Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5 |
| DeepSeek | DeepSeek V4.1 Flash |
| xAI | Grok 4.7 API |
| Moonshot AI | Kimi K3.1 Pro |
| Alibaba | Qwen 3.8 Max Prime |
| Meta | Meta Muse Ember, Meta Muse Spark Open |
| Z.ai | GLM 5.3 |
| MiniMax | MiniMax M3.1 Flash |
| Mistral | Mistral Large 4 |

**Availability notes.** Consumer Grok is paused. Grok 4.7 API is available for direct-model studies. DeepSeek V3, Llama 4 Maverick, Qwen 3.7 Max and GPT-5 Search are legacy choices limited to workspaces where they are already enabled. [Current model availability](https://docs.zerorank.ai/tracking/ai-models)

## Send your request

Email [support@zerorank.ai](mailto:support@zerorank.ai?subject=ZeroRank%20study%20request) or put your completed short form in a new Markdown file in this folder and open a pull request. Use a topic name such as `enterprise-support-platforms.md`. The engine list above is here for reference. The four-line form is all you need to copy.
